children: The U.S. dollar falls slightly against a basket of currencies, tracking a decline in Treasury yields ahead of the release of September consumer-price inflation data at 1230 GMT. Despite expectations of accelerating inflation in September, the data are unlikely to change market expectations of unchanged Federal Reserve policy rates this month, nor prospects of further rate increases in the coming months. The DXY dollar index falls 0.1% to 102.121, pulling away from Monday's 18-month high of 102.607. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
